hooks.text: 搜刮工具并制作针对性武器库，应对会持续演化的僵尸、变种人、外星人与机器人群
hooks.excerpt: Scavenge tools to craft an arsenal capable of dealing with the ever-evolving hordes of zombies, mutants, aliens, and robots in one of the deepest survival sims around.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 可组建幸存者队伍、安装军用义体，或主动变异成自己的怪物形态来适应末日
hooks.excerpt: Dig through the wreckage of shadowy government conspiracies to uncover the truth about the Cataclysm, form your own band of survivors, and adapt to the myriad threats by expanding your arsenal, installing military-grade bionics, or mutating into your own kind of monster.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 现实结构已经崩坏，最后一代人类究竟灭绝还是进化成适应新世界的物种由玩家决定
hooks.excerpt: The Last Generation tells the story of a world where the dead walk, alien horrors stalk the land, and the fabric of reality as we know it has come undone. Despite all this, a few unlucky souls yet survive, and whether the last generation of humanity is destined to die off, or to become something fit to survive in this brave new world is up to you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
